Literal source construction, not observed-event text search, defines exact arguments/scalar intervals and expected array plans. Eleven regex contracts include quoted syntactic matches; eight statement contracts include both nested-assignment and value-drop constructor branches and standalone array-plan value drops. Existing set_value references are compared at recorder/return time; no references or origins are invented for eighteen uninstrumented contracts. Complete regular Git population is a conservative supplied-input superset, not minimal observed IO; all actual commands retain full channels and before/after content/mode/population guards. Gitlinks/nonregular metadata excluded without payload reads. Book inputs are separately captured actual final publication bytes. Earlier exploratory output and initial removed array(items) selector rejection remain retained as limited preliminary observations; they are not promoted to the complete fixed-input acceptance. The successful bare-binding split diagnosis is freshly repeated in that acceptance. Read-only host OS/Perl/Python libraries/prove/mdBook are necessary external tools; project scratch remains on the repository volume. Source hooks .1.2.1/.1.2.2, null-source repair .1.2.1.1 and canonical family closeout .1.2.3 are scheduled separately. No production/spec/test/CI/hook/dependency change or native execution, executable membership, malicious callback, broader backend admission or historical audit closure is claimed.
